story: HI *{name}*! I'M *APOORV*, A DESIGNER FROM LUCKNOW.
I'VE DESIGNED FOR *12+ YEARS*: BRANDS, CAMPAIGNS, DECKS AND TEAMS.
A RESUME LISTS WHAT I DID. SO I BUILT A *GAME* THAT SHOWS IT.
I DESIGNED THE STORY, THE LEVELS AND EVERY PIXEL. *AI TOOLS* HELPED ME BUILD IT.
EACH WORLD IS A CHAPTER OF MY CAREER. READY? *LET'S GO!*

rita.name: RITA
lines: WELCOME, *{name}*! I'M RITA. I RUN THE LOBBY.
THIS OFFICE IS *APOORV'S STORY*: 7 WORLDS, 12+ YEARS. THE GOLD *?* COINS HOLD HIS FIRST 10 FACTS.
*ARROWS* WALK. *SHIFT* RUNS. *UP* JUMPS, AND *UP AGAIN* IN THE AIR DOUBLE-JUMPS.
*SHIFT+UP* IS A LONG JUMP. ON A GREEN PIPE, PRESS *DOWN* TO GO INSIDE.
MOUSE? *SCROLL* WALKS, *CLICK* JUMPS. STUCK? PRESS *R* FOR THE LAST CHECKPOINT.
again: TEN GOLD *?* COINS, {name}. THE FIRST ONE IS JUST AHEAD.

raju.name: RAJU
lines: COFFEE, *{name}*? FRESH FROM THE PANTRY.
APOORV RUNS ON IT. YOU GET *SPEED* AND A *TRIPLE JUMP*.
again: TOO MUCH COFFEE? NEVER. TAKE ANOTHER.

meera.name: MEERA
lines: NICE WORK, *{name}*! THE LOBBY IS DONE.
APOORV TURNS *COMPLEX IDEAS* INTO CLEAR STORIES. THAT IS WHAT MAKES HIS WORK STAND OUT.
NEXT: THE *TRAINING CAMPUS*. SEE YOU THERE!
again: THE DOOR IS RIGHT THERE, {name}.

prof.name: PROF. DAS
lines: WELCOME TO THE *TRAINING CAMPUS*, {name}! I'M PROF. DAS.
APOORV STUDIED FOUR SUBJECTS HERE. FINISH EACH *TASK* TO OPEN THE GATE AND EARN A *SCROLL*.
NO EXAMS. THIS IS WHERE HE LEARNED TO *THINK*, NOT JUST DRAW.
again: FOUR GATES, {name}. START WITH THE COLOUR LAB.

profEnd.name: PROF. DAS
lines: FOUR SCROLLS, *{name}*! THAT IS A LOT OF LEARNING.
NEXT: THE *OFFICE FLOORS*. THIS IS WHERE IT ALL WENT TO WORK.
again: THE DOOR IS OPEN, {name}. OFF YOU GO.

floor1.name: ZARA
lines: WELCOME TO THE *FREELANCE* FLOOR, {name}. 2013 TO 2016.
NO BOSS HERE. JUST *CLIENTS* AND DEADLINES.
COLLECT THE 4 CLIENT BADGES: BHOOMI, VIBAANTA, GLOBAL EDUCATION AND 13JUGAAD.COM.
THAT STARTS THE ELEVATOR.
again: FOUR BADGES, {name}. THEN TAKE THE ELEVATOR.

floor2.name: MEERA
lines: FLOOR 2: *BHOOMI EDUCATIONAL CONSULTANCY*. NOV 2016 TO DEC 2020.
APOORV'S FIRST FULL-TIME ROLE. THE ENEMY IS THE *VAGUE BRIEF*.
STOMP IT TWICE TO TURN IT INTO A CLEAR DESIGN.
again: STOMP THE VAGUE BRIEF, {name}. TWICE.

floor3.name: ANITA
lines: I'M THE CREATIVE DIRECTOR AT *DELOITTE DIGITAL*. JUN 2021 TO APR 2022.
HERE APOORV MADE NEWSPAPER ADS FOR THE US, UK AND AUSTRALIA.
TODAY'S ENEMY: THE *DEADLINE CLOCK*. STOMP IT!
again: TICK TOCK, {name}. STOMP THE CLOCK.

floor4.name: SAM
lines: THIS IS *JLL*. APR 2022 TO AUG 2024. APOORV LED OUR DESIGN TEAM.
ONE BRAND, MANY MARKETS. THE *OFF-BRAND BEAST* KEEPS CHANGING COLOURS.
STOMP IT THREE TIMES TO KEEP THE BRAND *CONSISTENT*.
again: WE'RE BEHIND YOU, {name}. THREE STOMPS.

floor5.name: THE CEO
lines: THIS IS *WSP*. AUG 2024 TO TODAY.
APOORV DESIGNS PRESENTATIONS FOR *GLOBAL LEADERSHIP*.
THE *100-SLIDE DECK* IS LOOSE! STOMP IT THREE TIMES TO MAKE IT CLEAR.
again: THE MEETING IS WAITING, {name}. THREE STOMPS.

floor5End.name: THE CEO
lines: NOW *THAT* IS A DECK I CAN PRESENT. WELL DONE, {name}!
THAT IS THE WHOLE JOURNEY. NEXT: THE *SKILL ARCADE*.
again: GO ON, {name}. THE EXIT IS RIGHT THERE.

cheer.name: TEAM
lines: WE'VE GOT YOUR BACK!
again: KEEP THE BRAND CONSISTENT!

skill1.name: RAVI
lines: WELCOME TO THE *SKILL ARCADE*, {name}. THREE CABINETS, *15 SKILLS*.
EACH COIN IS A SKILL. IT SHOWS *WHERE APOORV USED IT*.
SOME COINS SIT IN *PIPE ROOMS*. EACH ROOM IS A MINI-GAME. WIN IT TO UNLOCK THE COIN.
THOSE MINI-GAMES ARE HIS *GAME DESIGN* WORK TOO: PUZZLES, TIMING AND LEVELS.
again: 15 SKILLS IN TOTAL. YOU HAVE *{skills}* SO FAR.

skillEnd.name: RAVI
lines: *{skills}/15* SKILLS, {name}. NICE WORK!
THREE WORLDS LEFT: THE *TROPHY HALL*, THE *DRAGON'S LAIR* AND THE *ROOFTOP*.
again: YOU HAVE *{skills}/15* SKILLS. MISSING ONES ARE IN THE PIPE ROOMS.

curator.name: MRS. KAPOOR
lines: WELCOME TO THE *TROPHY HALL*, {name}! I LOOK AFTER THESE SHELVES.
FIVE CERTIFICATES ARE INSIDE *? BLOCKS*. JUMP UP AND HIT EACH ONE *FROM BELOW*.
again: FIVE BLOCKS, {name}. HIT THEM FROM *BELOW*.

curatorEnd.name: MRS. KAPOOR
lines: *{certs}/5* CERTIFICATES, {name}! APOORV NEVER STOPS LEARNING.
NEXT: THE *DRAGON'S LAIR*. IT GUARDS THE EXIT.
again: *{certs}/5* CERTIFICATES SO FAR, {name}. ANY BLOCKS MISSING?

rooftop.name: MEERA
lines: YOU MADE IT TO THE *ROOFTOP*, {name}! THE WHOLE TEAM CAME TO CHEER.
THE SIGNS SHOW *HOW TO REACH APOORV*. WHEN YOU ARE READY, RAISE THE *FLAG*.
again: SIGNS FIRST, THEN THE FLAG, {name}.

bHire.name: THE FLAG
lines: THANKS FOR PLAYING, *{name}*!
APOORV: *12+ YEARS* OF DESIGN, NOW *SPECIALIST AT WSP*.
HE DESIGNS, TELLS STORIES AND *BUILDS NEW THINGS*. LIKE THIS GAME.
RAISE THE FLAG TO FINISH. THEN *LET'S TALK*!
again: RAISE THE FLAG TO FINISH, {name}.

bResume.name: RESUME
lines: PREFER A *CLASSIC RESUME*?
PRESS ENTER AGAIN TO *OPEN IT*.
again: PRESS ENTER AGAIN TO *OPEN* THE RESUME.

dragonIntro.name: MEERA
lines: STOP, *{name}*! THE *DEADLINE DRAGON* GUARDS THE EXIT.
APOORV BEATS DEADLINES WITH *PLANNING* AND *CLEAR COMMUNICATION*.
IT BREATHES FIRE. *JUMP* THE FLAMES OR HOP ONTO THE LEDGES.
WHEN IT'S *TIRED*, STOMP ITS HEAD. OR *CLICK* TO THROW POINTER ARROWS.
again: STOMP ITS HEAD WHEN IT'S TIRED, {name}. NOT BEFORE.
